title: Regional MSL Manager, Neuroscience (Europe)
description:
**Description**


We are seeking an experienced and scientifically credible Regional MSL Manager to lead and support a team of Medical Science Liaisons across Europe within Neuroscience and Psychiatry.  

This role will focus on leveraging field medical expertise to accelerate clinical trial delivery through investigator engagement, site support, patient identification, enrolment, and retention initiatives for priority neuroscience programmes. The Regional MSL Manager will combine people leadership responsibilities with a strong operational focus, ensuring the field medical team effectively supports clinical development objectives whilst maintaining high\-quality scientific exchange with healthcare professionals and external stakeholders.


Working closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and external study partners, the successful candidate will lead strategies that enhance study site performance, support patient recruitment goals, and generate valuable scientific insights from the field. The individual will remain closely connected to field activities, providing coaching and support to MSLs while driving excellence in trial support, stakeholder engagement, compliance, and execution.  

This position offers an opportunity to lead a high\-performing field medical team while contributing directly to the successful execution of clinical programmes and improved outcomes for patients living with neurological and psychiatric disorders.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Medical Science Liaisons across multiple European markets.
* Provide day\-to\-day line management, performance support, field coaching, and professional development for MSL team members.
* Develop and implement regional field medical strategies that support patient identification, enrolment, retention, and overall clinical trial execution.
* Partner closely with Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and study teams to identify and address barriers to site activation and patient recruitment.
* Ensure MSLs maintain effective territory engagement plans with investigators, research centres, and referral networks to support study objectives.
* Support study feasibility assessments and site identification activities by leveraging scientific expertise and field insights.
* Facilitate compliant scientific engagement with Principal Investigators, study coordinators, healthcare professionals, and research site personnel.
* Accompany MSLs in the field to enhance scientific engagement capabilities and ensure consistent execution of best practices.
* Gather, analyse, and communicate actionable field insights relating to study execution, recruitment challenges, treatment pathways, and investigator needs.
* Work collaboratively with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Market Access, and Commercial teams to ensure aligned execution of programme objectives.
* Support clinical study steering committees, investigator meetings, advisory interactions, and other study\-related activities as appropriate.
* Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators related to field medical activities, site engagement, recruitment support, and team effectiveness.
* Support onboarding, training, and capability development programmes for new and existing MSL team members, including clinical trial support competencies.
* Ensure all activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable regulations, industry codes, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), pharmacovigilance requirements, and company policies.

**Requirements:**

* Advanced scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, MBBS, MSc, or equivalent).
* Previous experience as a Medical Science Liaison with demonstrated success in a field medical role.
* Prior line management, team leadership, or mentoring experience within Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or Field Medical organisations.
* Strong scientific knowledge within Neuroscience, Psychiatry, or related therapeutic areas.
* Experience supporting clinical research, clinical trial execution, site engagement, patient recruitment, or investigator\-sponsored studies.
* Working knowledge of clinical development processes, trial operations, and Good Clinical Practice (GCP).
* Experience collaborating with Clinical Operations, Clinical Development, and cross\-functional study teams.
* Proven ability to engage effectively with healthcare professionals, key opinion leaders, investigators, and research site personnel through scientific exchange.
* Ability to translate field insights into meaningful recommendations that support both Medical Affairs and Clinical Development objectives.
* Strong communication, coaching, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within complex cross\-functional pharmaceutical or biotechnology environments.
* Solid understanding of compliance, pharmacovigilance, and ethical requirements governing medical activities and clinical research interactions.
* Ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures within a matrix organisation.
* Fluency in English; additional European languages are advantageous.


Willingness to travel extensively across Europe. This role offers the opportunity to shape regional neuroscience strategy, lead diverse international medical teams, and drive scientific excellence across multiple global markets while improving outcomes for patients affected by neurological and psychiatric disorders.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

Located in northern Italy, our Palazzo Pignano plant serves as a key center for the production and development of dialysis\-related medical devices. With more than 550 employees, the plant specializes in manufacturing both peritoneal dialysis (PD) disposables and hemodialysis (HD) bloodline components. It combines large\-scale production capabilities with strong R\&D and engineering expertise. By utilizing advanced technologies to ensure the highest standards in dialysis product manufacturing, we’re not only driving innovation — we’re also creating meaningful change for patients worldwide.


Join our passionate team and be part of this global impact!

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


As a **Senior Supplier Quality Expert CATS**, you will play a key role in driving Supplier Quality Management activities in Palazzo Pignano manufacturing site. You will be responsible for ensuring supplier compliance, product quality, and continuous improvement throughout the supply chain, while supporting strategic supplier development and regulatory compliance initiatives.


Working closely with Procurement, Operations, R\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Engineering, and external suppliers, you will contribute to maintaining the highest quality standards for our medical device manufacturing operations.  



  

**Your Responsibilities**
=========================

**Supplier Quality Management**
-------------------------------

* Lead Supplier Quality Management activities within the Bloodlines division.
* Implement and maintain Supplier Quality Assurance systems in alignment with global FMC policies and procedures.
* Drive supplier qualification, selection, auditing, and continuous development programs.
* Ensure supplier compliance with quality requirements and regulatory standards.
* Support supplier process validation, risk management, and change management activities.
* Assess and approve supplier\-related changes through Change Control processes.

**Supplier Audits \& Compliance**
---------------------------------

* Plan and conduct on\-site and remote supplier audits in accordance with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Monitor supplier performance and quality metrics.
* Ensure material and product quality across the entire supply chain.
* Support site and supplier transfer activities.
* Collaborate with Regulatory Affairs and Quality teams to ensure ongoing compliance.

**Quality Systems \& Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------

* Investigate and manage supplier\-related deviations, complaints, and CAPA activities.
* Analyze supplier performance data and develop improvement plans.
* Prepare and present supplier performance reviews and management reports.
* Identify quality risks and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Promote continuous improvement initiatives and best practices across the supplier network.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**
-----------------------------

* Act as a key quality partner for Procurement, Operations, R\&D, Regulatory Affairs, Supplier Engineering, and manufacturing sites.
* Support SOP deployment and training activities across the assigned plants.
* Provide expert guidance on supplier quality topics and quality management processes.
* Collaborate with suppliers, notified bodies, and regulatory agencies when required.

**Your Profile**
================

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Quality Management, or a related technical field.
* Several years of experience in Quality Management, preferably in Supplier Quality or Supplier Management.
* Experience in supplier qualification, audits, supplier development, and quality system implementation.
* Strong knowledge of supplier quality tools and methodologies.
* Experience working in a regulated environment, preferably within MedTech, pharmaceutical, or healthcare industries.
* Fluent English; German language skills are considered a strong advantage.

**Technical \& Professional Skills**
------------------------------------

* Strong knowledge of GMP requirements and quality management systems.
* Good understanding of ISO 9001, ISO 13485, MDSAP, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Practical experience with CAPA, 8D, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and Change Control processes.
* Experience with process validation in medical device manufacturing.
* Knowledge of manufacturing commodities such as plastics, chemicals, electronics, or injection molding.
* Advanced skills in Excel, SAP, KPI analysis, reporting, and dashboard creation.
* Experience with TrackWise or equivalent Quality Management Systems is preferred.
* Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement methodologies is an advantage.
* Project Management experience is highly desirable.

**Personal Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong analytical mindset and structured problem\-solving approach.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence, moderate discussions, and drive decisions.
* High level of accountability and organizational capability.
* Team\-oriented attitude with strong intercultural awareness.

Ability to work effectively in a global and matrix organization.  
* 

  

**Our Offer for You**
---------------------


There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have \- all dedicated to your professional journey.

  

* Whether in front of or behind the scenes \- you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world

description:
IRCCS San Raffaele Scientific Institute in Milan, Italy, is looking for a Pre or Post\-Doctoral Fellow to join the Biology of Myelin Unit, led by Dr. Maurizio D’Antonio. (https://research.hsr.it/en/divisions/genetics\-and\-cell\-biology/biology\-of\-myelin.html)
  
  

**Main activities:**  

Our research unit is dedicated to unravelling the molecular mechanisms underlying Charcot\-Marie\-Tooth (CMT) diseases, with a specific focus on the genetic and pharmacological modulation of stress pathways, axonal degeneration, and gene editing strategies. We have developed a cohort of genetically modified mice carrying mutations in MPZ and PMP22, which we use to systematically investigate disease mechanisms and identify therapeutic avenues. Our main areas of focus include protein misfolding, the Unfolded Protein Response (UPR), and pathways that lead to axonal degeneration. In particular In previous work we have demonstrated how a significant number of mutant proteins causing CMT are retained in the endoplasmic reticulum where they activate a UPR, and we have demonstrated how modulation of this pathway may provide benefit in disease models (D’Antonio et al., J. Exp Med: , 2013; Das et al., Science, 2015; Bai et al., Mol. Neurobiol: , 2022, Touiver et al., Brain, 2025\).

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. We are seeking a **(Sr) Project Manage**r to join our **Early Development Services Team** in the **EMEA region**. We seek Phase I experience for this role.

  

The Project Manager serves as the Project Lead and primary sponsor contact and is accountable for the overall delivery of the project (quality, time, cost) on behalf of the organization. Additionally, the Project Manager establishes and communicates customer expectations to the project team and ensures that escalation pathways are adhered to internally and externally. The role involves leading the cross functional project team to meet or exceed deliverables.  

  

**What You'll Do:**  

* Serve as the primary contact between the sponsor and the organization at the project level.
* Ensure escalation pathways adhered to internally and externally (Rules of Engagement – communication pathways).
* On projects where the scope requires, ensure clear delineation in responsibilities and communication pathways for secondary project leads (such as lead in a specific region, lead for a specific vendor(s) or subset of delivery).
* Accountable for the overall delivery of the cross\-functional project (time, cost, quality).
* Ensure financial stewardship at a project level by demonstrating an intimate understanding of the contract, resource alignment to budget, management of Out of Scope activity, drive the Con Mod process/negotiations and team execution to timelines.
* Establish, communicate and manage customer expectations to achieve optimal delivery during the project
* Drive Risk Identification and Issue Resolution at project level (RBQM/RESOLVE).
* Ensure project team compliance with organization policies, SOPs, ICH\- GCP, regulatory and project specific requirements.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification

*Years of experience refers to typical years of related experience needed to gain the required knowledge, skills, and abilities necessary to perform the essential functions of the job. Years of experience are not to be used as the only determining factor in establishing the job class or making employment selection decisions.*  

  

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**  

* Technical and systems competency, such as computer skills, to include effective use of systems and applications such as Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint, as well as organization systems (CTMS, Preclarus, Clarity)
* Ability to delegate and effectively prioritize own and workload of project team members in a frequently changing environment
* Effective oral and written communication and presentation skills
* Proactive, solutions oriented and adaptable to changing priorities and situations
* Advanced therapeutic area knowledge and clinical development guidelines and directives
* Strong understanding of the key principles of project management (time, quality, cost), including solid financial acumen

* Good judgment and decision making skills and capable of applying critical and analytical strategic thinking skills to manage complex/ambiguous situations
* Ability to negotiate, persuade and influence others, including a cross cultural awareness.

  

**Working Conditions and Environment:**  

* Work is performed in an office/ laboratory and/or a clinical environment.
* Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
* Exposure to electrical office equipment.
* Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.

When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence.
